zh.nbCatHint: 整理笔记分类与层级。移动分类不会更改笔记正文。
zh.nbCatLoadFailed: 暂时无法载入分类，已保留当前分类。请重试。
zh.nbCatSaveFailed: 分类未能保存，输入内容已保留。请重试。
zh.nbCatConflict: 分类已在其他窗口更新。已尝试载入最新分类，请检查后重试。
zh.nbCatBuiltinHint: 默认分类名称随界面语言显示。可以调整位置与层级。
zh.nbCatDragHint: 拖到行上沿或下沿可排序，拖到行中央可移入。
zh.nbCatKeyboardHint: 也可使用父分类选择框和上移、下移按钮调整位置。
zh.nbCatSelectHint: 选择左侧分类可重命名或移动。新增分类的父分类可独立选择。

en.nbCatHint: Organize note categories and their hierarchy. Moving a category preserves note content.
en.nbCatLoadFailed: Categories could not be loaded. The current tree is preserved. Please retry.
en.nbCatSaveFailed: The category was not saved. Your input is preserved. Please retry.
en.nbCatConflict: Categories changed in another window. Reloading the latest tree was attempted. Review it and retry.
en.nbCatBuiltinHint: Default category names follow the interface language. Their order and hierarchy can be changed.
en.nbCatMoveToParent: Move to the end of selected parent
en.nbCatDragHint: Drop near a row edge to reorder, or in its center to nest.
en.nbCatDropRoot: Move to the end of root level
en.nbCatKeyboardHint: You can also use the parent selector and Move up / Move down buttons.
en.nbCatSelectHint: Select a category on the left to rename or move it. Choose the parent for a new category separately.
